text:
Zara Kim: quick check  prototype for 'first touch' entry: bottom dock (small persistent) vs centered overlay (micro-modal). attaching comps: fig://onboard/dock.png fig://onboard/overlay.png
Noah (Design): dock feels less scary; overlay grabs attention but blocks quick scans.
Miguel (Eng): dock is way easier: no focus trap, simpler mobile behavior. overlay needs focus management and z-index checks.
Anya (Growth): overlay might convert faster initially; dock could be better long-term. would like to A/B both for 2 weeks.
Riley (a11y): accessibility nits: overlay must restore focus to the previously focused element, announce role="dialog" and have aria-modal=true. dock needs visible focus rings and a skip link to main content. contrast on dock CTA is 3.4:1 now  needs to hit 4.5:1.
Noah (Design): noted, i'll bump color and add 3px focus outline for both. copy ideas:
- "Start a sample in 60 seconds" / CTA: "Start sample"
- "Explore starter apps" / CTA: "Browse samples"
Miguel (Eng): prefer short CTA "Start sample" for dock; overlay can use "Browse samples". also add a per-user "hide" toggle persisted via user settings.
Anya (Growth): propose experiment split: 40% dock, 40% overlay, 20% control (no prompt). need tracking: onboard.show, onboard.cta_click, onboard.sample_created.
FlagBot: Created experiment flag exp.onboard.first_touch.v1 with rollout 40/40/20.
Riley (a11y): i'll run quick keyboard + NVDA smoke once builds land. share staging URL here.
Zara Kim: action list: Noah update comps by EOD, Miguel stub flag and persist hide state, Riley a11y QA, Anya hook up dashboards. reconvene after 7 days of data. :white_check_mark:
